title: Towing Dispatch Authorization Form
subtitle: Towing Dispatch: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Towing Dispatch Authorization Form turns disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery into a customer-facing Towing Dispatch consent record. The towing dispatch coordinator itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the vehicle owner / request authority's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Towing Dispatch Authorization Form at roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location. Verify applicable Towing Dispatch requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the vehicle owner / request authority's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery scope or cost changes.

sections.title: Authorization request and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Towing Dispatch, identify responsible parties, roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location, and the linked disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery source.

fields.label: Vehicle VIN or plate, make, model, color, and location
Truck, operator, equipment, destination, and custody references

sections.title: Requested scope, limits, and decision lines
sections.guidance: Capture Towing Dispatch facts for disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Towing Dispatch authorization checks
items: Road, traffic, weather, visibility, and scene safety
Vehicle position, damage, mobility, drivetrain, and clearance
Tow method, attachment, securement, and special equipment
Occupant, key, property, and law-enforcement context
Departure, route, storage, and destination handoff

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Towing Dispatch conditions; have towing dispatch coordinator assign the next Towing Dispatch owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Vehicle requires different equipment or recovery plan
blocks.guidance: Pause Towing Dispatch when scene safety, authority, equipment fit, securement, destination, or vehicle custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Towing Dispatch proof and route unresolved disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery scope to towing dispatch coordinator.

fields.label: Authorizing authority: Qualified Towing Operations Reviewer
